unity_coordinate_system: legacy formula from AgentScripts/prepare_campus.py; north-aligned X east/Z north
assumptions: OSM topology and Unity road centerlines are source geometry, not approved vehicle access.
Missing access permission is a simulation assumption only; explicit restrictions remain excluded.
Speed is a configured 30 km/h (8.333333333333334 m/s) assumption, never an observed speed or legal limit.
OSM missing oneway follows the simulation bidirectional assumption; explicit oneway is preserved.
Road widths remain unknown; visual mesh widths are not measurements.
Length is horizontal AEQD distance; Terrain height, slopes and physical driving are not modeled.
Stops are projections of Unity general entrance candidates onto existing road segments within 35 m.
Entrance-to-stop gap is straight-line separation, not a validated pedestrian route.
No step-free access is certified; requests requiring it are rejected.
Three synthetic vehicles; one request each; no boarding/dwell time or multi-vehicle collision coordination.
Only original campus centerlines and explicitly pinned extension corridor intervals are enabled; no whole-network expansion.
Battery capacity, energy rates and charge power are synthetic configurable assumptions, not vehicle measurements.
Three independent ideal 1000 W home charging ports at main_gate; no charger travel beyond the planned return.
Standby vehicles power down: no idle drain. Auxiliary power is applied throughout travel; charging power is net stored power.
All legs including home return plus 15 percent capacity reserve are required before dispatch; load correction applies to delivery only.
